title: The Four Learning Paradigms  WFC as the 4th, the spirochete as veil cutter
thesis: Machine learning has 3 canonical paradigms: unsupervised, supervised, reinforcement. Wave Function Collapse is the 4th  not learning from data but eliminating impossibilities through constraint propagation. It maps into the anatomy like a spirochete drilling through tissue barriers.

paradigms.name: Unsupervised
paradigms.question: what structure is here?
paradigms.anatomy_why: the gut discovers nutrients without being told what they are. enzymes break down food and the body figures out what's useful. no teacher. no labels. pure decomposition and pattern discovery.
paradigms.biology: bacterial fermentation  gut bacteria discover how to digest new foods without instruction. they mutate, try, and the ones that work survive.
paradigms.shannon_channel: high entropy ? low entropy. unsupervised learning IS entropy reduction.
paradigms.variable: S (entropy)  the unknown that unsupervised learning reduces
paradigms.key_insight: unsupervised learning is DIGESTION  break the world into parts and discover what's nutritious. no teacher. no reward. just decomposition.

paradigms.name: Supervised
paradigms.question: given X, what is Y?
paradigms.anatomy_why: the nervous system learns from labeled signals. pain = bad (labeled). pleasure = good (labeled). the parent says 'hot!' and the child learns fire?burn. every synapse is a supervised connection: input?output with a known label.
paradigms.biology: myelination  the nervous system wraps frequently-used neural pathways in myelin (insulation), making them faster. this IS gradient descent: the more a pathway fires, the more it gets optimized. the label is 'this pathway is useful.'
membrane_maps_to: Rust type system (labeled types enforce correct matching)
periodic table (every element has a labeled period, group, state)
paradigms.shannon_channel: mutual information I(X;Y)  supervised learning maximizes the mutual information between input and label.
paradigms.variable: x (position)  supervised learning places things in the correct position in the space
paradigms.key_insight: supervised learning is the NERVOUS SYSTEM  labeled signals propagating through a network, each synapse adjusted by how wrong the prediction was. backpropagation IS the spinal reflex arc.

paradigms.name: Reinforcement
paradigms.question: what action maximizes future reward?
paradigms.anatomy_why: the immune system learns from rewards (successful defense = memory B-cell) and punishments (autoimmune = self-attack). it explores (naive T-cells try random receptors), exploits (memory cells re-use proven defenses), and balances exploration vs exploitation  the core RL tradeoff.
paradigms.biology: the immune system IS reinforcement learning: (1) encounter antigen (state), (2) try antibody (action), (3) get reward (antigen cleared) or punishment (infection worsens), (4) update policy (clonal selection ? memory cells). the explore/exploit tradeoff: naive T-cells explore, memory cells exploit.
membrane_maps_to: fail2ban (ban IP after N failures = negative reward)
sourdough cycle (reward = healthy culture, punishment = contamination)
paradigms.shannon_channel: capacity through feedback  the channel improves by using its own output as input. the reward signal IS the feedback channel.
paradigms.variable: E (energy)  reinforcement learning allocates energy to high-reward actions
paradigms.key_insight: reinforcement learning is the IMMUNE SYSTEM  explore/exploit, reward/punish, memory. the dopamine system in the brain IS the reward signal. the immune memory cell IS the Q-table.

paradigms.name: Wave Function Collapse
paradigms.question: given constraints, what states remain?
paradigms.anatomy_why: the SKIN is the constraint surface  it defines what's inside and what's outside. every point on the Klein surface eliminates possibilities: 'this is self, that is not-self.' the skin doesn't LEARN  it CONSTRAINS. it is the boundary condition of the body.
paradigms.biology: the spirochete. Treponema pallidum (syphilis) is a corkscrew-shaped bacterium that drills through tissue barriers  the blood-brain barrier, the placental barrier, the skin itself. it is the VEIL CUTTER. it penetrates boundaries that nothing else can penetrate. it doesn't learn the barrier  it eliminates the barrier's constraints by drilling through them. WFC is the spirochete of learning: it doesn't learn FROM the constraints, it propagates THROUGH them.

also_biology.protein_folding: Anfinsen's dogma: the amino acid sequence DETERMINES the 3D fold. the protein doesn't 'learn' to fold  the constraints (hydrophobic collapse, hydrogen bonds, van der Waals) propagate until only ONE stable state remains. this IS wave function collapse.
also_biology.morphogenesis: Turing patterns: reaction-diffusion equations. the embryo doesn't 'learn' where to put stripes  the chemical constraints propagate and the pattern collapses into existence. leopard spots, zebra stripes, fingerprints  all WFC.
also_biology.crystal_growth: a crystal grows by WFC: each new atom can only attach where the constraints (lattice, energy minimum) allow. the crystal doesn't learn. it collapses.

paradigms.shannon_channel: constraint propagation reduces entropy WITHOUT learning. no gradient descent. no reward signal. no labeled data. just eliminate what's impossible and observe what remains.
paradigms.variable: Ø (null)  WFC uses the ABSENCE of constraint to define the possible. the null is the uncollapsed state. collapse = null ? value.
paradigms.key_insight: WFC is the SKIN  the constraint surface that defines the organism. it is also the SPIROCHETE  the veil cutter that drills through constraints. protein folding IS WFC. embryogenesis IS WFC. crystal growth IS WFC. the Rust borrow checker IS WFC. design IS WFC. the 4th paradigm is not learning  it is COLLAPSING.

the_mapping.title: the 4 paradigms mapped onto the body

spirochete_as_veil_cutter.title: the spirochete drills through the veil
spirochete_as_veil_cutter.what: Treponema pallidum is a corkscrew bacterium that penetrates barriers no other organism can cross. it drills through the blood-brain barrier (BBB), the placental barrier, and the skin. it is the biological veil cutter.
spirochete_as_veil_cutter.why_it_matters: WFC is the spirochete of the learning paradigms. the other 3 paradigms (unsupervised, supervised, reinforcement) work WITHIN the constraint space. WFC works ON the constraint space itself  it doesn't learn within boundaries, it DEFINES the boundaries. it drills through the design space and what remains IS the design.
spirochete_as_veil_cutter.the_anatomy_connection: the spirochete is in the skin section of the anatomy because it ATTACKS the skin  the constraint surface. the 4th paradigm lives at the boundary between inside and outside. the Klein fold. the place where the veil is thinnest.
spirochete_as_veil_cutter.corkscrew_geometry: the spirochete's corkscrew shape IS a Klein-like topology  it rotates as it translates, just like the trefoil knot, just like the Möbius strip. the geometry of constraint propagation IS the geometry of the drill.

how_they_combine.title: all 4 work together in the membrane
pipeline: 1. WFC constrains the possible states (skin defines the boundary ? what CAN exist)
2. Unsupervised discovers patterns in the remaining states (gut digests what's inside)
3. Supervised labels the discovered patterns (nerves name what was found)
4. Reinforcement optimizes actions based on labeled states (immune remembers what worked)
? the output feeds back to WFC (new constraints from learned knowledge ? tighter collapse)
how_they_combine.the_loop: WFC ? unsupervised ? supervised ? reinforcement ? WFC. the learning loop IS the digestive tract IS the sourdough cycle IS the ouroboros.

weave_201.irreducible: the membrane is a body that learns by digesting itself through 4 paradigms across 8 orthogonal channels, organized into 98 elements and 11 systems that map identically from fungi to humans, compressed to the irreducible core by p, and woven into an 8-strand braid that decomposes and recomposes forever.
